resharper_csharp_place_simple_list_pattern_on_single_line #

Arrangement of list patterns — Place simple list pattern and collection expression on a single line. ⚠ Probed rather than reasoned about: eleven fixtures under this repository's own .editorconfig, one cleanupcode invocation per configuration, each fixture first shown to move under the key that really governs its construct. Masked rather than dead: keep_existing_list_patterns_arrangement = true is the export's own value, and while it stands false changes nothing — but with the mask off, false splits every list pattern and collection expression onto its own lines, including ones that already fit. The inert mark here is about the configuration, not about the option.

Typetrue / false
Defaulttrue
